notes: Pointer steps: zrender Handler mousemove / mousedown + mouseup + click / mouseout from outside the canvas; each 10 ms after the last; a frame of every chart after every step.
State e / b: emphasis / blur in currentStates of data.getItemGraphicEl(i) (a symbol: its path), by raw index.

cases.note: an axis tooltip over a bar and a line: each move downplays what the last one lit and highlights its own rows (downplay first), off the grid and on a leave everything goes down; the line's symbol and its polyline
the root axisPointer component says triggerEmphasis: false: no highlight, no downplay, nothing lit
the x axis' own axisPointer.triggerEmphasis: false over the root's true
tooltip.axisPointer.triggerEmphasis: false is not one of the fields the tooltip hands its axes: the rows still light
a cross over two category axes: the other arm is a category axis too, so it involves the series and its rows light as well; then the same with the y axis' triggerEmphasis off
emphasis.focus series on the bar: the axis' highlight says notBlur, so nothing blurs; a hover on the bar element itself (the axis trigger keeps its tooltip) is the element's own hover
a series whose own tooltip says trigger item takes no part in the axis: its rows never light
by hand: updateAxisPointer at a point, showTip by seriesIndex + dataIndex (the axis detour), hideTip (the pointer and its rows stay), updateAxisPointer currTrigger leave
two connected charts: A's highlight says escapeConnect and stays in A; B lights its own rows from the updateAxisPointer it follows
a line with showSymbol false: LineView.highlight builds a temporary symbol for the row and downplay takes it away again
two grids linked {xAxisIndex: all}: the linked axis' rows light too, one batch for both
a polar bar under an axis tooltip: the angle axis' rows light

guards.what: the first move lights b in both series
escapeConnect, a batch of {seriesIndex, dataIndex} with notBlur
the category cross arm lights its rows too
the y arm off: fewer rows
each chart lights its own rows
the linked axis' row is in the batch
